subject.title: Feature Request: Configurable Session Lane Concurrency + Auto-Yield

question: What session scheduler contract should OpenClaw support before adding per-session concurrency or auto-yield config?
rationale: The source-level issue is real, but changing one-session-at-a-time behavior affects transcript integrity, active-run ownership, cancellation, final reply delivery, and public config shape, which are product and architecture choices rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Define scheduler contract first
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and require an explicit concurrency/yield design before any implementation PR changes session-lane behavior.

options.title: Narrow to diagnostics only
options.body: Treat the warning threshold as the only near-term scope and leave session concurrency and auto-yield deferred until a separate design is sponsored.

options.title: Default-off experimental knob
options.body: Allow a highly constrained opt-in session-concurrency experiment if maintainers accept the upgrade and session-state risk.

recommendation.title: Define scheduler contract first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and require an explicit concurrency/yield design before any implementation PR changes session-lane behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for command-queue concurrency and diagnostics is on the scheduler files that would need the product contract.
